rows.en: By the way, is your mom feeling better?

That was ages ago...
She was fine after a day, and now she's
back to nagging me nonstop.
Glad to hear it.
rows.notes: x4: also nml_myk_010 (Shirakawa's training went well); fits.

rows.en: It's all thanks to you.
rows.notes: The player's advice on food for the sick (scene before).

rows.en:
Well, shall we go shopping?
There's something I've been wanting.
You've got... great taste, as always.
rows.notes: Literally 'you have good sense as always'. Read as ironic: the next lines (Kagura: 'I think it's normal', player: 'if he doesn't mind, not my place to say', '(His fashion sense, huh...)') show his taste is odd. The pause marks the irony.

rows.en: You think so? I think it's pretty normal...

Well, if the man himself doesn't mind,
I guess it's not my place to say anything.
(His fashion sense, huh...)

(I've got plans to go out with Kagura-kun
today...)
Oh... Here he comes!

Well, if the man himself doesn't mind,
it's not my place to say anything.
(The view from Griffith Park is the best.)

Huh...?
Who's that over there...?
Oh, it's you.

It's rare to run into you here.
What were you up to?
Oh, I was just sort of looking at the sky.
I see. It's a nice view, after all.
Is that... an EX-Gear?
You're right. Maybe a Mihoshi student?
Probably.
Do you feel like flying too, Yuuto?
Nah, I think I'd rather have a Valkyrie...

Flying all around the vastness of space...
I want to protect this Frontier...
our world.
Yeah, I see.

It might sound naive, but I want to protect
everyone. I'll spare no effort to do it.
You're always training, aren't you?
I want to be as prepared as I possibly can.
But overdoing it is bad for your body.

Well, you've got a point.
Besides... if something happened to me,
my mom would be all alone.
Oh... I see...

And I haven't even repaid her
for everything yet...
rows.notes: oyakoukou = doing right by one's parent.

rows.en:
I think staying healthy already
counts as repaying her.
But I've got to make her life easier...

Then you'd better work hard, huh?
Just don't push yourself too much!
Yeah, you're right!
It's a handshake.
rows.notes: Answers the player's 'Hm? What's wrong?' as he holds out his hand.

rows.en: A-a handshake?
Here's to both of us chasing our dreams.
Y-yeah!
Th-that hurts, Yuuto!!
Oh, uh, sorry.
All right! Let's give it our all!
Yeah!

(Yuuto's really been thinking
about a lot of things.)

(Mmm~! The view from Griffith Park
is the best.)

It's rare to run into you here.
What were you up to?
Do you feel like flying too, Kagura-kun?
Mm, I see.
rows.notes: x3: also frd_luk_007 and frd_nns_004 as a listening reply; fits.

rows.en: Oh... I see... So that's how it is...

I think staying healthy already
counts as repaying her, though.
Y-yeah, let's do our best!
Th-that hurts, Kagura-kun!!

(Kagura-kun's been thinking about
a lot of things too.)
(Yuuto's at Griffith Park again.)
Seriously, this view is great every time.

\p, huh...
Yeah, the view from here calms me down.

To think this is all inside the Macross...
Human technology really amazes me.

We live ordinary lives here, but we're
still inside a ship, after all.
I wonder where this ship will end up...
Hmm, let's see...

Well, one thing I can say is, I hope it's
a planet with beautiful scenery.
Couldn't agree more.
rows.notes: x6: also Michel (frd_mcl_006, to 'sorry for bothering you', dry) and Alto (nml_alt_007, agreeing); works for all.

rows.en:
Well, I'm heading home.
What about you?
I think I'll stay and look a little longer.
I see. Well, see you.
(A new planet, huh...)
(Kagura-kun's at Griffith Park again.)
Seriously, this view is great every time.

To think this is all inside the Macross...
It totally blows my mind.
Hmm, let's see...

For now, I hope it's a planet with
beautiful scenery, I guess?
I think I'll stay and look a little longer.
(A new planet, huh...)
rows.notes: x5: also nml_cla_003 and nml_kgr_003 (a new planet was found); fits.
